name: Adrammelech
overview: The name Adrammelech appears in Scripture both as an Assyrian idol and as a son of King Sennacherib. The people of Sepharvaim worshipped Adrammelech alongside Anammelech, even burning their children in fire to these gods, revealing the idolatrous practices condemned in the Old Testament. Additionally, Adrammelech was one of Sennacherib's sons who assassinated their father while he was worshipping the god Nisroch, demonstrating the tragic consequences of turning away from the true God. These passages highlight the dangers of idolatry and familial betrayal in a context opposed to God's sovereignty.
